root_cause_label: Hardcoded Exact Account Matching Misses Typo Variant BUS-30g01 with Premature Submission
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent hardcoded only the three account numbers visible in grep results without considering that account numbers themselves could contain typos, causing the transaction with account BUS-30g01 to be silently excluded from the output.
t_err_evidence: Step 4 writes filter_transactions.py with exact account-number whitelist ['BUS-30001', 'BUS-30999', 'BUS-35001'], never considering that account numbers may also contain typos (e.g., BUS-30g01); the company-name grep in steps 2-3 would not have revealed this account-number typo variant.
t_commit_evidence: Step 5 executes the flawed script which writes output.json with exactly 8 transactions, omitting the BUS-30g01 row; from this point the incomplete output file is the deliverable and the agent never re-generates it.
trigger_explanation: The agent assumed the set of relevant account numbers was completely enumerated by the company-name grep (BUS-30001, BUS-30999, BUS-35001), without verifying whether account numbers themselves could be typoed variants of the canonical account. This unverified assumption caused BUS-30g01 to be excluded from the filter logic.
